title: An `acceptedAt` with the right shape and impossible values
why: `2026-99-99T99:99:99Z` matches the punctuation and the digit counts and is not a date, so a validator asserting the schema's `date-time` format refuses what a pattern check accepts — the same gap the pattern was added to close, one level down. Shape is checked by the pattern; meaning by a round trip through the calendar.
